description: A by-locale resolver whose answer encodes WHICH locale it was handed. 'en' and 'fr-CA' are loaded -- distinct primary languages, so tiebreakers stays null -- and the mapping names 'en' and 'en-US' with a LUNAR default, so an en-US request served by the en catalog is distinguishable from one where the requested tag were passed through, and a fr-CA request reaches the resolver's own default. The en-US mapping entry is what makes the absence of the requested tag falsifiable rather than assumed.
